source.evidence: The combined conflict-free Sequence witness gives an exact structural boundary: Recordare ends at q1410 where the meter returns to 4/4; Lacrimosa begins at q1578 where the meter changes to 12/8. Confutatis is therefore q1410-q1578, importer source measures 386-427 inclusive (42 source measures).
